data.long_meaning: Venessa is a Latin name derived from Venus, the Roman goddess of love, beauty, and fertility. The name evokes feelings of passion, grace, and nurturing. In Christian tradition, Venessa may represent the love and grace of God. The name Venessa carries the meaning “Venus, goddess of love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Venessa usually hope their child will grow to embody venus, goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
